title: Vanilla Comfort Plus
description: A lightweight, fully clientside modpack focused on small quality-of-life tweaks that make vanilla Minecraft more comfortable to play.
body:
**Vanilla Comfort Plus** is a fully clientside quality-of-life modpack designed to enhance the Minecraft experience without changing what makes vanilla special. It focuses on small, practical improvements that make gameplay smoother, more comfortable, and more enjoyable — whether you're building, exploring, or surviving.

This modpack does not add new dimensions, items, mobs, or mechanics. Instead, it refines the existing game with smart tweaks, helpful HUD features, better visuals, improved performance, and modern convenience tools.

## **✨ What Vanilla Comfort Plus Offers ✨**

Vanilla Comfort Plus is built around one simple idea:

_Keep Minecraft vanilla — just make it better to play._

**That means:**

- No gameplay changes
- No balance changes
- No progression changes
- No server-side mods required

Just a cleaner, smoother, more comfortable experience.


##  Fully Clientside

_This modpack is fully clientside and works on:_
- Vanilla servers
- Paper / Spigot servers
- Singleplayer worlds
### ⚠ Server Compatibility & Fair Play Notice

This modpack is fully clientside, but some public servers may **restrict** certain mods.
Please **check** each server’s **rules before joining**.

On private servers, there are usually no restrictions.
